Methodology and limits

  • Exact member_class/config match only, constrained by structure_field_id, member scope and effective date. No synonyms.
  • Current config is a future renewal candidate, never proof of historic price/config. Start, price, rail and payment are not inferred from expiry.
  • ISO and unambiguous slash dates only. Ambiguous slash dates remain review unless per-row provenance exists; no cohort-wide assumptions.
  • GoCardless joins use unique exact normalized primary/alternative email, then customer→mandate→payment. Mandate and direct-debit custom values are hints, not payment evidence.
  • Invoice candidates preserve exact references and constrained unique identity matches. Name, amount or date alone never auto-links. Legacy CSV timestamp is unknown and PAID does not prove a live rail. The Xero account scan is partial when invoicesComplete is false, so absence here is never a definitive no-invoice finding.
  • Existing history is not reconstructed. Complete normal commitments are NO CHANGE. All provider pagination/status limits are disclosed below.

The spreadsheet contains all 3822 members with mapped structures, proposed dates, provider references and explanations. The detailed JSON retains every invoice/payment candidate, original field values and incomplete canonical record fields. The payment-method and invoice-review groups require otherwise-complete membership details; their zero counts do not mean those checks have passed.
